description:
Edited assets are skipped by a full Smart Search re-index and never get an embedding

Assets that have been edited in the built-in image editor are skipped by a
full Smart Search re-index. After running "Smart Search → All", these assets
end up with no row in the `smart_search` table, and a subsequent
"Smart Search → Missing" run does not pick them up either — the job completes
immediately and reports nothing to do.

Editing by itself does not break anything: an already-indexed asset keeps its
embedding after being edited. The embedding is lost only once a full re-index
is performed.

Requesting similar photos for an affected asset returns:

{"message":"Asset <id> has no embedding","error":"Bad Request","statusCode":400}
